findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler with only `pass`, but StatefulDetectorHandler declares abstract members (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and the newly added `build_occurrence_and_event_data`). Since the class is an ABC with unimplemented abstract methods, `Detector.detector_handler` calling `group_type.detector_handler(self)` will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler` whenever a metric_alert_fire detector is processed, breaking process_detectors for this type at runtime rather than being caught at import/type-check time.

findings.title: Unchecked DetectorPriorityLevel -> PriorityLevel conversion can raise ValueError
findings.body: `PriorityLevel(new_status)` converts a DetectorPriorityLevel into PriorityLevel by raw value. Any DetectorPriorityLevel value that does not have an exact numeric counterpart in PriorityLevel (e.g. future/extra levels) will raise ValueError inside evaluate_group_key_value, aborting evaluation of the data packet. The conversion should be an explicit mapping or guarded, and should be covered by a test for each possible priority level (current tests only exercise HIGH).
